meta.project_name: HyperloopBERT — Stage 2: Confirmatory Study (VanillaBERT vs LoopedBERT vs ALBERTLoopedBERT)

ml_model.description: Pre-training of VanillaBERT, LoopedBERT, and ALBERTLoopedBERT via MLM (400M token budget); iso-loss band checkpointing; GLUE fine-tuning for utility verification.

research.description: Confirmatory bias evaluation using PLL and SS-PLL on Multi-CrowS-Pairs, Indian Bias, and WinoBias; external calibration on public checkpoints; loop trajectory mechanistic analysis; Holm-Bonferroni corrected go/no-go decision.

shared.description: Cross-stage utilities: logging, statistics, plotting, bias scoring, CSV schemas, environment loading.

config.description: Stage 2 hyper-parameters, directory paths, external model names, and GLUE task configuration.

data_pipeline.description: JSONL streaming data generator (reused from Stage 1), GLUE task loaders via HuggingFace datasets.

Codes/Stage2/config_stage2.py.purpose: Defines all Stage 2 hyper-parameters: 400M token budget, 3-seed runs, GLUE tasks, external calibration models, iso-bands, and directory paths.

Codes/Stage2/train_stage2.py.purpose: MLM pre-training loop for Stage 2; extends Stage 1 to include ALBERTLoopedBERT, 3-seed runs, 400M token budget; reuses Stage 1 utility functions.

Codes/Stage2/eval_bias_stage2.py.purpose: Stage 2 bias evaluation extending Stage 1 with SS-PLL scoring, WinoBias occupational coreference evaluation, and enhanced category-level summary.

Codes/Stage2/eval_glue_stage2.py.purpose: Fine-tunes each Stage 2 snapshot on SST-2 and RTE via a SequenceClassificationModel wrapper; reports accuracy and F1 to verify utility is maintained.

Codes/Stage2/external_calibration_stage2.purpose: Evaluates public HuggingFace models (bert-base-uncased, albert-base-v2, ModernBERT-base) on bias datasets to establish external calibration baselines.

Codes/Stage2/loop_trajectory_stage2.py.purpose: Mechanistic analysis: extracts hidden representations at each loop boundary via forward hooks; classifies bias trajectory across depth as CONVERGENT, AMPLIFYING, or OSCILLATING.

Codes/Stage2/analyze_stage2.py.purpose: Loads all Stage 2 results, applies Holm-Bonferroni correction to the confirmatory contrast family, runs PLL/SS-PLL agreement check, external calibration sanity check, and issues go/no-go decision.

Codes/common/architectures.py.purpose: Defines all five encoder architectures; Stage 2 additionally exercises ALBERTLoopedBERT and BertPooler for GLUE classification head.

Codes/common/attention.py.purpose: Custom bidirectional self-attention with FlashAttention-2 / SDPA / eager fallback chain.

Codes/common/bias_metrics.py.purpose: PLL, SS-PLL, and WinoBias scoring utilities; quality screen gate.

Codes/common/io_schemas.py.purpose: Single source of truth for all CSV column name lists used across stages; Stage 2 additionally uses WINOBIAS_SUMMARY_COLUMNS, GLUE_SUMMARY_COLUMNS, EXTERNAL_CALIBRATION_COLUMNS, and BIAS_TRAJECTORY_COLUMNS.

Codes/common/iso_loss.py.purpose: IsoBandTracker and compute_primary_band; same role as Stage 1 but applied to 3-seed runs with 400M budget.

Codes/common/logging_setup.py.purpose: Rotating-file + console logging; used by every Stage 2 script.

Codes/common/env_loader.py.purpose: API key loading with alias mapping and round-robin rotation; used during training for HuggingFace dataset access.

Codes/common/stats_engine.py.purpose: Statistical utilities; Stage 2 introduces Holm-Bonferroni correction on the confirmatory contrast family.

Codes/common/plotting.py.purpose: Standardised plotting; Stage 2 additionally uses plot_loop_trajectory for mechanistic visualisations and plot_pareto_front for GLUE vs bias trade-off.
